info.title: Authenik8 Full-stack API
info.description: The public browser-facing contract for an Authenik8 full-stack application. Authenik8 owns identity, refresh rotation, session revocation, roles, and backend authorization. Browser clients keep access tokens in memory, send the HttpOnly refresh cookie with credentials, and obtain a CSRF token before mutations. Frontend route guards are not an authorization boundary.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token. Keep it in memory; never persist it in browser storage.

csrfCookie.description: Signed CSRF cookie issued by GET /api/auth/csrf.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Echo the token returned by GET /api/auth/csrf. Send credentialed requests.

Sets a matching HttpOnly CSRF cookie. Use credentials: include and send the returned token in X-CSRF-Token on mutations.

Returns a short-lived access token and sets the refresh token only in an HttpOnly cookie.
Rotates the Redis-backed refresh session once. Clients must share one in-flight refresh and must not retry indefinitely.
